verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026. The resolution's own text could not be stored: the UN Digital Library record (official_url) returns a bot-check page, the press.un.org meeting coverage GA/12588 returns a JavaScript 'Client Challenge' page also in a browser, and documents.un.org is closed to automated downloads by robots.txt. Stored for this record: the UN News article of 21 March 2024 (secondary source), a news item that gives the date, the adoption without a vote and quotations of the operative text; its quotes count as alt-official. The General Assembly's list of the resolutions of its 78th session (un.org) was stored in this run, but the stored copy lists only resolutions 78/319 to 78/331 and does not show 78/265. The recheck of 17 Oct 2026 stored further un.org pages that name the resolution, its number and date: the spokesperson's briefing of the President of the General Assembly of 21 March 2024, the UN Photo caption of the adoption, A/RES/79/325, which recalls '78/265 of 21 March 2024', and the High-level Advisory Body's final report. The summary is written from the operative text that UN News quotes.
